user.title: Connect a Busch-Jaeger thermostat
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth address of your 1095 UTA-BT. A nearby ESPHome Bluetooth proxy can provide the connection.

menu_options.installation: Upload installation export and enter its password

installation.title: Import installation credential
installation.description: Export the installation from free@home Next. The upload is deleted after processing; only the derived secret is saved.

secret.title: Enter ACS secret
secret.description: Use the 64 hexadecimal characters derived from your installation. The printed device PK is a different credential.

connect.title: Validate connection
connect.description: Disconnect the phone app and check the nearby Bluetooth proxy. Submit to retry. For a different credential, cancel setup and start again.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_export: The installation export is invalid or uses an unsupported format.
error.invalid_secret: Enter a 32-byte ACS secret as 64 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Check that the installation export and password match this thermostat.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check Bluetooth proxy reachability and available connection slots.

abort.not_connectable: An active Bluetooth adapter or proxy is required.

init.title: Temperature range
init.description: Set the range offered by Home Assistant to match your installation. These settings do not change the thermostat’s own limits.

error.invalid_range: The minimum temperature must be lower than the maximum.
